_what: The PRIOR arm env base, as it was actually submitted: the env_overrides blob of the 2026-09-01 eval run record, copied VERBATIM and nothing else.
_source_rule: .gitignore:39 data/batch_runs/ -- the record itself is NOT in the repository
_why: configs/graphrag/arm_env_base.yaml reconstructs the prior base and records a diff_vs_prior_base against it; tests/unit/test_submit_eval_parity.py grades that diff by asserting every ADDED key was absent from the prior job env. Reading the untracked run record made a TRACKED deck depend on an input no clone has, so five pins SKIPPED on a fresh clone -- a deck that cannot run from its own commit. This fixture is the one field of that record the deck reads, tracked, so the pins run everywhere.
